newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: John Govett Asia unit trust gets S$29mln at launch.
newsitem.headline: John Govett Asia unit trust gets S$29mln at launch.

text.p: John Govett (Asia) Ltd said on Tuesday investors had committed Singapore $28.9 million to its newly launched Govett Global Brands Fund by late Monday.
John Govett, part of Allied Irish Banks plc, said in a statement the funds had come mainly from retail investors.

Govett Global Brands, launched in July and investing in 35 to 40 stocks mainly in the U.S., Europe, Japan and South Korea, is the second unit trust investment vehicle the company has introduced in Singapore.
The first, Govett Asia Pacific Growth Fund, was launched in November 1995 and has achieved a return of about 33 percent as at June 30, 1997, the company said.
